result.topic_en: A fair-copy text page on the mechanics of the ear: the theory is said to hold for the attentively listening ear, followed by an anatomical description of the ossicular apparatus (hammer, anvil, stirrup) and its axis of rotation.

items.english: Our investigation then remains valid for the listening ear, deliberately prepared for exact hearing, while alongside this the possibility always remains that the ear (the waking one?) is continually adapted, even if perhaps to a lesser degree.
